title: Dynamic Student Profile Application
description: Uses AngularJS Expressions, Modules, and Controllers to dynamically bind and preview student profiles, calculating GPA and academic standing in real-time.

title: College Management Modular Architecture
description: A modular architecture assembling studentModule, facultyModule, and courseModule into a master collegeApp with isolated controller domains.

title: Student Attendance Application
description: Comprehensive demonstration of conditional and repetition directives: ng-repeat, ng-if, ng-show/ng-hide, and ng-switch for multi-case status badges.

title: Dynamic Product Billing Application
description: Two-way bound line item management with automatic calculation of subtotals, item-level discounts, GST slabs, and a printable customer invoice.

title: Library Multi-Controller Management
description: Coordinates BookInventoryCtrl, MemberRegistryCtrl, CirculationCtrl, and LibraryStatsCtrl via a central shared LibraryService singleton.

title: Interactive Student Mark Analysis System
description: Two-way binding evaluating theory, internal, and practical mark components, generating visual progress bars with ng-style and semester GPA.

title: Dynamic Product Catalog Application
description: Built-in directives (ng-repeat, ng-src, ng-class, ng-disabled, ng-cloak) combined with custom directives <product-stock-tag> and <star-rating>.

title: Student Performance Management System
description: Deep dive into $scope lifecycle and $scope.$watch listener methods, automatically auditing mark variations and issuing academic risk notifications.

title: College Department Nested Scopes Application
description: Demonstrates hierarchical scopes from DeanCtrl down to DepartmentCtrl and LabCtrl, illustrating prototypal inheritance and $parent access.

title: Searchable & Sortable Employee Directory
description: Uses built-in filters (filter, orderBy, currency, uppercase, date) and a custom experienceLevel filter with interactive sortable table headers.

title: Student Result Analysis Application
description: Multi-criteria filtering by department, status, and dynamic score range slider, computing class statistics, highest mark, and distinction rates.

title: Cascading Department & Course Selection
description: Four-tier dependent cascading dropdowns: Degree Level ➔ Department ➔ Semester ➔ Course Selection with ng-options and ng-change.

title: Interactive To-Do Management Application
description: Event directives (ng-click, ng-dblclick, ng-keydown, ng-blur) with dynamic DOM classes, inline task editing, and status filtering.

title: Interactive Image Gallery Application
description: Mouse events (hover preview, zoom, likes) and keyboard listeners (Left/Right arrow navigation, Escape modal close, Spacebar slideshow).

title: Real-Time Digital Operations Dashboard
description: Built-in services ($interval digital clock and telemetry sync, $timeout auto-dismissing toast alerts, $log) and custom ServerMetricsService factory.

title: Online Course Enrolment Form
description: Form validation states ($valid, $invalid, $dirty, $pristine), regex patterns, elective module checkboxes, and dynamic fee computation.

title: User Login & Registration System
description: Client-side authentication with tab switching, password strength entropy scoring, password match validator, and simulated active sessions.
